svg.title: Taskly · Data model
svg.desc: Entity relationship diagram of Taskly. A project has contributors and task items; a task item has subtasks and may link to another task item. Comments, time entries and attachments belong to either a task item or a subtask. Comments have replies and reactions. Users have refresh tokens. Notifications, system tasks and deletion logs reference rows by id only.
svg.text: EF Core on SQL Server: the tables, their keys and how they relate
Referenced by id only, no foreign key:
they point at many kinds of rows,
or at rows that are already gone.
